title: RouteDiscovery
summary: Resolve authorized route definitions for a URL that no known route matches.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: The router calls discover when no route matches a URL, or only a splat does. Return the routes to add, or none when the path is unknown or denied. The router inserts them by specificity, shares one request between concurrent callers and remembers a denial until resetDiscovery. Rejections are not remembered, so a later attempt retries.

sections.title: Generated discovery
sections.body: applicationPlugins builds discover for you in virtual:smolter/routes. Write your own only for manual route arrays; the Vite plugins keep the router's discovery support only when routeDiscovery is configured, so manual discovery needs a build without them or with routeDiscovery set.
